description: This PHP source file defines the UserService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing various user management functionalities such as saving users, retrieving user information, deleting users, handling passwords, and user role management.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class providing operations related to user management, including CRUD operations, password handling, role retrieval, and user search functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: geUserDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPasswordHasher
methods.description: Returns the PasswordHash instance used for hashing and verifying passwords.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Saves a system user to the database, handling password hashing and product mode restrictions.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a system user by user ID.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on system users with given IDs.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches a user role based on role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: isCurrentPassword
methods.description: Verifies if the provided password matches the current password of the user.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on provided credentials, handling password verification and hash updates.

methods.name: checkPasswordHash
methods.description: Verifies if a given password matches the stored hash.

methods.name: checkForOldHash
methods.description: Checks if the password matches an older hash format (MD5).

methods.name: getUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of users that cannot be deleted, such as the logged-in user and default admin in demo mode.
